I will think this through like I do every year.

My 5 mu is not much, but it feeds part of our family of 7 and brings some cash. Two of my children work in the city, so I mostly farm with my wife. At 53, I still have strength, but I do not want to waste money on things that do not pay back.

**Winter wheat** — I plant it in October after the maize comes off. I use improved seed from the dealer in town, the kind most people around here plant — "Jimai" something, I forget the number but the dealer knows. Last year it gave me about 450 kg per mu, which is normal for our village. I do not try anything strange. What my neighbors plant, I plant.

For fertilizer, I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15, 40 kg bags) as base when I plow — that is 80 kg per mu. Then in spring when the wheat turns green, I topdress with half a bag of urea, maybe 25 kg per mu. My father taught me: wheat eats nitrogen in spring. If I am short one year the yield drops, and losing 50 kg of wheat costs more than the extra urea. So I would rather add a little more.

Water — I irrigate 4 times: before winter to keep roots warm, green-up in spring, jointing, and grain filling. We have the well, so water is not the main cost, just the electricity.

Spray — once for weeds in spring, once for aphids and scab around flowering. Two sprays is enough most years.

I use rotary tillage. Everyone uses the rotary machine now, we hire it for about 40 yuan per mu.

**Summer maize** — After wheat harvest in June, I direct-seed maize right into the stubble, no plowing. I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu type — nobody plants the old varieties anymore, they yield half as much.

Base fertilizer: 1.5 bags of compound (60 kg per mu) at seeding. Then when maize is knee-high, I side-dress urea, about 30 kg per mu. Maize eats more nitrogen than wheat, and in a wet year it grows tall and needs it.

Irrigation: maybe 2 times if the rain is short. July-August usually has rain, so sometimes I only water once.

Spray: once for armyworm and corn borer. Sometimes twice if the bugs are bad.

Yield target about 550 kg per mu — that is what I got last two years.
